description: Session 11 golden GENERATION set. Extends the (corrected) Session 10 retrieval golden set (evals/golden_retrieval.json, queries Q1-Q5, budget-only) with an expert reference estimate (ground_truth) per query, so RAGAS can score the generated estimate against a reference. question = the estimation request; transcript = the meeting notes fed to the pipeline; ground_truth = the reference estimate (engineer-days, 8h/day) an expert would produce from the relevant historical budgets. Engineer-days are derived from the recorded estimated_hours of the relevant budgets' components in data/budgets_sample.json.

queries.query: Mobile banking application with OAuth2 authentication, PSD2 open banking compliance, strong customer authentication and a transaction ledger.
queries.transcript: Client kickoff call with FintechCorp. They are a neobank and want a mobile banking application. Must-haves: an OAuth 2.0 authentication backend covering PSD2 strong customer authentication (SCA) on every payment initiation, an instant payments integration, push notifications for transaction confirmations and security alerts, and an operations admin dashboard. They also mentioned wanting a double-entry transaction ledger as the source of truth for balances, similar to a ledger built for a previous payments project. Stack is Ruby on Rails with PostgreSQL and Redis. Regulated EU fintech sector, PSD2 compliance is non-negotiable.
queries.ground_truth: Reference estimate ~85 engineer-days, grounded mainly in BUD-2024-014 (mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 and instant payments, 480h). Modules: Authentication — OAuth 2.0 backend covering PSD2 SCA, ~15 engineer-days (AUTH-001, 120h). Payments — instant payments gateway integration, ~25 engineer-days (PAY-002, 200h). Notifications — push notifications for transaction confirmations and security alerts, ~10 engineer-days (NOTIF-003, 80h). Operations — admin dashboard, ~10 engineer-days (DASH-004, 80h). BUD-2024-014 alone has no ledger component, so the double-entry transaction ledger is grounded instead in BUD-2024-040 (card issuing platform, LEDGER-001, 200h, ~25 engineer-days) — a supporting cross-project source, not the bullseye. Confidence high for auth/payments/notifications; medium for the ledger module since it is derived from a different (though closely related) historical project.

queries.query: Headless e-commerce storefront with a product catalog, shopping cart checkout and personalized product recommendations.
queries.transcript: Retail client (ShopFlow) wants a headless e-commerce storefront. Scope: a faceted product catalog with content management, a shopping cart and one-page checkout, real-time product search, and personalized product recommendations based on browsing history rather than just best-sellers. The front end is a React storefront replacing an old AngularJS site. Checkout should use Stripe. They are explicitly not building a multi-vendor marketplace. Medium scale, B2C, EU. Stack is a Node backend with a React storefront.
queries.ground_truth: Reference estimate ~95 engineer-days, grounded mainly in BUD-2024-021 (headless e-commerce storefront with real-time search and one-page checkout, 620h). Modules: Shopping Cart — cart and session management, ~18 engineer-days (CART-001, 140h). Product Search — real-time product search, ~23 engineer-days (SEARCH-002, 180h). Checkout — one-page checkout with Stripe, ~20 engineer-days (CHECKOUT-003, 160h). Catalog CMS — catalog content management, ~18 engineer-days (CMS-004, 140h). BUD-2024-021 has no recommendations component, so personalized recommendations are grounded in the supporting source BUD-2024-070 (fashion shopping app, WISH-002 wishlist and recommendations, 130h, ~16 engineer-days). BUD-2023-015 (grocery store catalog/checkout) is a secondary supporting analog for catalog/checkout patterns, not added to the total. Confidence high; the marketplace vendor-payout scope explicitly out of bounds must NOT be added.

queries.query: Telemedicine platform for patient appointment scheduling and video consultations with HL7/FHIR integration and clinical records.
queries.transcript: Healthcare provider (MedConnect) wants a telemedicine platform. Requirements: patient appointment scheduling, video consultations between patients and clinicians, HL7/FHIR integration with their existing hospital systems, and electronic clinical records with proper interoperability. Regulated healthcare sector, EU, GDPR plus clinical data handling. Stack is a Python backend. They mentioned SMS appointment reminders and e-prescription as nice-to-haves but the core ask is scheduling, video, FHIR and records.
queries.ground_truth: Reference estimate ~89 engineer-days, combining two complementary historical budgets — neither alone covers the full scope. Video Consultations — from BUD-2024-052 (telemedicine platform, TELE-001, 220h), ~28 engineer-days. Appointment Scheduling — from BUD-2023-008 (EHR platform, APPT-002, 120h), ~15 engineer-days. HL7/FHIR Integration — from BUD-2023-008 (HL7-003, 140h), ~18 engineer-days. Electronic Health Records core (clinical records) — from BUD-2023-008 (EHR-001, 220h), ~28 engineer-days. BUD-2024-052's e-prescription (RX-002) and insurance billing (BILL-003) are out of the stated core scope and left as optional add-ons, not summed into the total. BUD-2023-045 (multi-clinic scheduling) is a secondary supporting analog. Confidence high: this is the clearest multi-source synthesis case in the set, since the video-consultation budget and the FHIR/scheduling/records budget are two distinct, non-overlapping historical projects.

queries.query: Industrial IoT platform ingesting sensor telemetry for predictive maintenance and real-time equipment monitoring in a factory.
queries.transcript: Manufacturing client (FactoryOps) wants an industrial IoT platform for a factory. Scope: ingest sensor telemetry from equipment, a predictive maintenance engine that flags failures before they happen, a manufacturing execution module for shop-floor tracking, and operational reporting. Real-time equipment monitoring should integrate with their existing PLC/SCADA layer. Industrial sector, on-premise plus cloud, high data volume. They also want future SAP integration (IDoc/BAPI) to auto-create maintenance work orders from predictive-maintenance alerts, to be scoped separately.
queries.ground_truth: Reference estimate ~88 engineer-days, grounded mainly in BUD-2024-033 (industrial IoT platform for SCADA telemetry, predictive maintenance and shop-floor execution, 700h). Modules: Telemetry Ingestion — SCADA telemetry ingestion, ~30 engineer-days (SCADA-001, 240h). Predictive Maintenance — predictive maintenance engine, ~25 engineer-days (MAINT-002, 200h). Manufacturing Execution — shop-floor execution module, ~23 engineer-days (MES-003, 180h). Operational Reporting — ~10 engineer-days (RPT-004, 80h). BUD-2024-061 (smart factory quality control, PLC-001 PLC data connector, 180h, ~23 engineer-days) is a supporting analog for the real-time equipment-monitoring/PLC-connectivity angle — noted as a candidate module but not folded into the core total since the query's monitoring requirement is already substantially covered by SCADA-001. Confidence high/medium.

queries.query: Real-time payments gateway with fraud detection, transaction reconciliation and a double-entry ledger.
queries.transcript: Fintech client wants a real-time payments gateway. Requirements: a payment gateway core processing transactions in real time, a real-time fraud detection engine, transaction reconciliation against settlement records, and a double-entry ledger for accounting integrity. They also want KYC/AML onboarding for merchants and webhook delivery for downstream settlement events. Regulated EU financial sector. Stack is a Python backend.
queries.ground_truth: Reference estimate ~78 engineer-days of GROUNDED scope, with one explicitly ungrounded requirement. Ledger — double-entry ledger, ~25 engineer-days (LEDGER-001, BUD-2024-040, 200h). KYC/Compliance — KYC/AML onboarding, ~20 engineer-days (KYC-002, BUD-2024-040, 160h). Gateway Core — payments-gateway integration, grounded in the supporting source BUD-2024-014 (PAY-002 instant payments gateway, 200h), ~25 engineer-days, since BUD-2024-040 (card issuing) has no gateway-core component of its own. Webhook Delivery / Reconciliation support — webhook delivery for settlement events, ~8 engineer-days (WEBHK-004, BUD-2024-040, 60h), the closest historical analog to 'transaction reconciliation' though not an exact match. Fraud Detection has NO historical analog anywhere in the corpus (neither BUD-2024-040 nor BUD-2024-014 nor any other budget has a fraud-detection component) — a correct system MUST leave this line ungrounded (grounded=false, no invented hours) and surface it as an Assumption, not estimate it by eye. This query is a deliberate stress test for the Session 11 grounding contract.
